title: History Of Film And Cinema
modules: The Concept Of History And Film…………………
The Concepts Of History And Film
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an audiovisual means of communication that uses the art of photography to convey messages."
Film is an audiovisual means of communication that uses the art of photography to convey messages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the record of past events, details of stories surrounding a project or a happenstance."
History is the record of past events, details of stories surrounding a project or a happenstance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Diaspora film shot in the United Kingdom, starring both British and Nigerian artistes."
Onye Ozi for instance is a Diaspora film shot in the United Kingdom, starring both British and Nigerian artistes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to when technology has expanded the nature of filmmaking and liberalized everything about the art."
The present era refers to when technology has expanded the nature of filmmaking and liberalized everything about the art.
fib: ______ refers to high budget films in Nigeria shot for widescreen cinema releases as is done in first cinemas of the world.
The concept of 'New Nollywood' films refers to high budget films in Nigeria shot for widescreen cinema releases as is done in first cinemas of the world.

The Silent Period refers to films produced between ….. and …….. 2.

The sound period refers to when sound was introduced into film.
